_about: Rule 2 frame operators. Every organization that operates, convenes or publishes a frame used in this study enters the candidate pool BY CONSTRUCTION, independent of whether it appears in any frame's listings. Operators are screened on C1-C5 and coded on the full instrument like any other record, are flagged frame_operator = TRUE, and are EXCLUDED from every within-block rate and from the saturation count, because their inclusion is guaranteed rather than sampled.
_blocking: The enumerator REFUSES TO RUN while any entry below has decision = UNDECIDED. Operators enter the pool at O3, so the list must be closed before enumeration, not during it.

settled.name: New America
settled.note: Co-convener of PIT-UN with Ford and Hewlett, 2019. Enters as a co-convener of a frame in use, not as an operator of the dropped NAPIT frame.

settled.name: Alliance of Civic Technologists
settled.note: AUTHOR-CONFLICTED. The lead author participates in ACT. Routed away from him entirely at screening, coding, adjudication and review; both RAs code it independently and any disagreement is reported unadjudicated.

settled.name: Code for America
settled.note: Brigade Network sunset June 2023. The frame is historical; the organization is not.

undecided.name: Schmidt Sciences
undecided.for: Listed as an operator in workbook sheet 3.
undecided.against: Dropped for being the WRONG TRADITION — fundamental science, not technology applied to social problems. Coding it as a TPG organization would be odd, and the registration's scope is operators of frames USED in this study.

undecided.name: Knight Foundation
undecided.for: Listed as an operator in workbook sheet 3; Code for America's first funder, historically central to civic technology.
undecided.against: Its frame was dropped, so it operates no frame in use.

undecided.name: Data Science for Social Good
undecided.for: Listed as an operator in workbook sheet 3; also the worked example under Rule 1, where it is logged as unit_known_not_surfaced via PITUN.
undecided.against: Its frame was considered and rejected.

undecided.name: DataKind
undecided.for: Listed as an operator in workbook sheet 3; ran the 2019 Google.org AI Impact Challenge jointly, so it touches a frame in use.
undecided.against: Its own frame was rejected as not enumerable.

undecided.name: National Digital Inclusion Alliance
undecided.for: Listed as an operator in workbook sheet 3.
undecided.against: Its frame was rejected; sheet 2 notes it may enter via FORD if it qualifies, which would make it an ordinary sampled record rather than an operator.

undecided.name: NetGain Partnership
undecided.for: Listed as an operator in workbook sheet 3 as a historical operator.
undecided.against: Its frame was rejected; roster is the 2015 founding membership with no evidence of activity after March 2024.

_how_to_settle: For each entry in `undecided`, set decision to IN or OUT and add a dated note. Move IN entries into `settled` with frame_operated, operator_status and website_url filled in. Then clean the originating_frame controlled values in codebook sheet 4: drop NAPIT, KNIGHT and SCHM unless the corresponding organization is retained here as an operator record.
_recommendation: On the registration's own wording — operators of frames used in this study — all six are OUT, and Schmidt most clearly so. This is recorded as a reading of the registered scope, not as a decision; the decision is the lead reviewer's and must be dated.
